findings.mechanism: categoryScope concatenates request.category into SQL WHERE text as a single-quoted literal without binding or escaping
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled category can break out of the quoted literal and inject SQL syntax into the categorySnapshot query.

additional_review_paths.resolution: ORDER BY fragment comes from a finite local mapping with a safe default.
Reviewed caller purgeReservation; SQL uses a bound named parameter for id.
categoryScope directly interpolates normalized request input into SQL syntax.
